name: Ojos-Albos (Spain)
description: Square flag of white and blue horizontal stripes crossed by a broad green diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ojos-Albos (a tower, a tree and a boar).
history: Municipal flag of Ojos-Albos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
